data.raw_text:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 29 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 21 July 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, San Antonio, Castillejos, San Marcelino, San Narciso, San Felipe, Cabangan, Botolan, Iba, Palauig), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose) and Pampanga(Mabalacat, Angeles, Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Cavite, Laguna and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan, Quezon, Pampanga(Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Guagua, Santa Rita), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia), Zambales(Candelaria, Masinloc, Santa Cruz), Metro Manila(Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, Marikina) and Rizal(San Mateo, Rodriguez) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
